comment: because i need to login every time a send a coment, allow sending commints in bulk instead of one by one.
resolutionNote: Traced this to a real bug, not a genuine bulk-send request: sending a reply, an edit, or a Jynx-feedback comment had zero error handling, so a session that expired mid-use failed completely silently — no message, nothing visibly happened. That's what read as 'I have to log in every time.' Added the same graceful 'log in again without losing your draft' recovery AnnotationPopover.jsx already had (jynx-mth55ybetlt5) to the Comments panel's own reply/edit/Jynx-composer actions — a clear error banner + inline password field, draft text never cleared on failure. NOT fixed: the actual root cause of sessions expiring so often — they live in an in-memory Map with no persistence, and Render's free tier wipes that on every idle spin-down, independent of the 7-day session TTL. Deliberately did not 'fix' that by git-committing session tokens (that would leak live credentials into permanent git history — a real security regression, unlike the bcrypt hashes in dev-users.json). The actual fix is infra-level (an external keep-alive ping, or a paid Render tier that doesn't spin down) — flagged to the founder rather than guessed at.
